results.title: UN warns of worsening humanitarian crisis in Niger as nearly 64,000 flee northern Nigeria - JURIST - News
results.snippet: Niger hosts more than half a million refugees and asylum seekers, in addition to people displaced within the country. Most of the new arrivals from Nigeria have sought refuge in the Diffa and Tahoua regions. More than 23,000 people have arrived in Diffa this year, and more than two-thirds are children.
